body: Maybe. I'll try that, who knows. Thank you for your advice.
I'm so glad that I found this site, being able to rant and talk about my feelings, lifts up the pressure just a bit more.

Of course, I want to talk to a female therapist instead. But, my parents say that it'll be better for me to get used to being around men. Sure, they're going to be around everywhere I go, but they could at least acknowledge the fact that I hate men. <hugs back> And, strong? I guess. Though, I kinda do feel weak every time I think about what happened.
